description: Unit tests for Google Crashdump Uploader using Google Test framework, mocking network interactions.

classes.name: MockLibcurlWrapper
classes.description: Mock class for LibcurlWrapper to simulate network interactions in tests.

classes.name: GoogleCrashdumpUploaderTest
classes.description: Test fixture class for GoogleCrashdumpUploader tests.

methods.name: InitFailsCausesUploadFailure
methods.description: Test that upload fails if initialization of network wrapper fails.

methods.name: TestSendRequestHappensWithValidParameters
methods.description: Test that SendRequest is called with correct parameters when uploading a valid file.

methods.name: InvalidPathname
methods.description: Test that upload fails if the file path is invalid.

methods.name: TestRequiredParametersMustBePresent
methods.description: Test that upload fails if required parameters (product name, version, client GUID) are missing.
